# Valyu

> knowledge work.

One API to search specialist, proprietary and web sources, and run multi-step research with cited, structured outputs — across Finance and Science & R&D.

## Set up Valyu

- [Agent onboarding runbook](https://www.valyu.ai/agents.md): Install, authenticate, and verify the Valyu CLI, MCP server, or SDK. Fetch and follow this to set Valyu up end to end.
- [Setup guides](https://www.valyu.ai/agents): Human-readable version, with deep links for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.
- [Integration reference](https://docs.valyu.ai/AGENTS.md): Endpoint choice, source presets, and how to query well.

## Documentation

- [Full Documentation](https://www.valyu.ai/llms-full.txt)

## Products

- [Answer & Deep Research APIs for AI Agents](https://www.valyu.ai/product-agents): From instant, cited answers to multi-step investigations that deliver reports, sheets and structured data
- [API](https://www.valyu.ai/product-apis): Search + content extraction in one platform
